headline: OpenAI reports engineering-task gains and early industry workflows with AI models
summary: In a 3 November 2026 report, OpenAI says an unnamed newer internal model averaged 0.875 on BenchCAD 2.0, compared with 0.594 for GPT-6 Astra at maximum reasoning effort. BenchCAD 2.0 documents 100 held-out cases across six tasks involving CAD reconstruction, assemblies and PCB connectivity, scored against references without an LLM judge in an offline sandbox. OpenAI also describes early workflows with Chip Ganassi Racing and a research collaboration with Mazda, where engineers review model outputs. These are first-party performance and workflow reports; the unnamed model, independent reproduction and measured workplace productivity or manufacturability outcomes remain unestablished.
